hooks.text: 利用地图高低地形与特殊格，亲手规划能困住敌人的塔防迷宫
hooks.excerpt: Use the maps' topography and special tiles to optimize your maze.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 30张独特手工地图坚持固定设计，不使用程序属性或电脑生成波次
hooks.excerpt: Discover new towers and monsters as you embark on an adventure that will take you through 30 unique maps. Created by a small independent team, handcrafted with passion and precision. Artisan TD features no procedural statistics or computer-generated waves.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把农场嵌入防御迷宫，以占用布局空间换取小型经济收益
hooks.excerpt: You'll be able to manage a small economy, taking the risk of integrating farms into your mazes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
